question: When we draw what we see outside, the window acts like a...? 🪟
explanation: Super! The edges of the window frame the beautiful view outside just like a painting! 🎨

question: What is the first step before drawing the view outside? 👀
explanation: Awesome! Looking closely helps us notice all the beautiful details before we start drawing! ✨
hint: It means to look with great focus.

question: When looking at a tree far away, how does it look? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Things that are far away always look smaller than they really are! 📏

question: If a bird is sitting right on your window sill, it looks...? 🐦
explanation: Fantastic! Objects that are very close to us look much bigger and clearer! 🔍

question: What shape do birds far up in the sky look like? 🦅
explanation: Perfect! When birds fly high and far away, their wings look like a tiny letter V! ✏️
hint: It is a letter after U.

question: What color is the sky early in the morning during sunrise? 🌅
explanation: Beautiful! The sunrise fills the sky with lovely warm colors like orange, red, and pink! 🌞

question: If you look out at night, what color should you use for the sky? 🌃
explanation: Super! Nighttime skies are deep blue or black, filled with twinkling stars! ⭐
hint: It is a very dark, cool color.

question: What shape are the roofs of houses in villages usually? 🛖
explanation: Awesome! Many houses have slanted, triangle-shaped roofs to let rain slide off! 🌧️

question: What shape are tall city buildings when you draw them? 🏢
explanation: Great job! Tall buildings and towers look like standing rectangles reaching for the sky! ⛅

question: When a tree is in front of a house, what can you NOT see? 🏡
explanation: Excellent! This is called overlapping. Things in front hide parts of things behind them! 🪄

question: What line should you draw to separate the sky and the ground? 🌍
explanation: Super! The horizon line is where the sky and the earth seem to meet in a drawing! 🏞️
hint: It is a straight line across.

question: How do you draw a road going far away into the distance? 🛣️
explanation: Great! Roads and paths look like they squeeze together into a point when they go far away! 📐

question: If it is raining outside, what should you draw in the sky? 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! Rainy days have dark, grey clouds filled with heavy water drops! ☔

question: What color makes leaves look fresh and healthy? 🍃
explanation: Beautiful! Green is the happy color of fresh leaves and nature growing outside! 🌱
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: When the wind blows hard, how should you draw the trees? 🌬️
explanation: Super! Drawing trees bending shows that the strong wind is pushing them! 🌪️

question: Which tool is best for drawing the first light sketch? ✏️
explanation: Great job! A light pencil helps you plan your drawing safely before coloring it! 📓

question: What can you use to fix a tiny pencil mistake? 🧽
explanation: Awesome! Erasers are magic tools that help us clean up mistakes and try again! ✨

question: If you want to color a big blue sky quickly, what is best? 🖌️
explanation: Fantastic! A thick paint brush or crayon helps you cover big areas like the sky very easily! 🌈
hint: You dip it in water and colors.

question: What is the best way to draw a fluffy cloud? ☁️
explanation: Super! Clouds are soft and fluffy, so wavy and bumpy lines are perfect for them! 🐑

question: What does a bright yellow sun make a drawing feel like? ☀️
explanation: Beautiful! Bright colors like yellow make our drawings feel cheerful, sunny, and warm! 🌻
hint: Think about a fun summer day.

question: When we draw mountains far away, what shape do they look like? ⛰️
explanation: Awesome! Mountains look like giant, bumpy triangles sitting on the horizon! 🏔️

question: What should you add to a drawing of a house to let light in? 🏠
explanation: Great job! Drawing windows makes a house look real and friendly! 🏘️
hint: You are peeping out of one right now.

question: What appears in the sky after the rain stops and the sun shines? 🌈
explanation: Super! A rainbow fills the sky with seven magical colors after the rain! 🌦️

question: If you look closely at a leaf, what do you see inside it? 🍂
explanation: Awesome! Leaves have beautiful tiny lines called veins that help them get food! 🌿
hint: They look like a tiny net.

question: What color is the trunk of most big trees? 🪵
explanation: Fantastic! Tree trunks are covered in brown bark that keeps the tree strong! 🌳
hint: It is the color of chocolate.

question: What do we call the dark shape a tree makes on the ground in the sun? 🌳
explanation: Great job! The sun creates cool, dark shadows when it shines on objects! ☀️
hint: It follows you when you walk outside.

question: If your window frame is a rectangle, your drawing paper should be...? 📄
explanation: Super! Using a rectangular paper helps perfectly capture what we see through a rectangular window! 🖼️

question: When drawing a river, what kind of lines work best? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! Wavy lines make the water in a river look like it is flowing and moving! 💧

question: What happens to the colors of things when the sun goes down? 🌇
explanation: Great! As light goes away, colors become darker and closer to black! 🌌

question: How can you make a drawing of a street look busy? 🛣️
explanation: Super! Drawing lots of vehicles and people makes a street look active and busy! 🚶

question: To draw a straight edge of a window, you can use a...? 📏
explanation: Awesome! Rulers help us draw perfectly straight, neat lines for houses and windows! 📐

question: What shows that a car in your drawing is moving fast? 🏎️
explanation: Great job! Drawing small swoosh lines behind a car makes it look super fast! 🏁

question: Where should you draw the roots of a tree? 🌱
explanation: Fantastic! Roots hide deep under the brown soil to drink water for the tree! 💧
hint: They are buried in the dirt.

question: If you look out and see stars, what time is it? 🌟
explanation: Beautiful! The twinkling stars only come out to play in the dark night sky! 🌌

question: Which of these makes a park drawing look fun? 🛝
explanation: Super! Swings, slides, and playing children make a park drawing feel happy and alive! 🎈
hint: You love to play on it.

question: To make grass look real, you can draw many...? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Lots of tiny, spiky green lines make the ground look like real grass! 🐛

question: What element makes a drawing of a winter day look cold? ❄️
explanation: Awesome! Adding white snow and bare trees instantly makes your drawing feel chilly! 🧣
hint: It falls from the sky in winter.

question: Which animal might you see peeping outside a city window? 🏙️
explanation: Super! Pigeons and small birds are our lovely little neighbors in the city! 🕊️
hint: It is a bird that coos.

question: What is the very top part of a drawn picture called? 🖼️
explanation: Great! The top part of the drawing is usually where we put the beautiful sky! ☁️

question: When you color neatly inside the lines, your drawing looks...? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! Taking your time to color neatly makes your artwork shine bright! ✨

question: If you are drawing a tall tree, you should hold your paper...? 📄
explanation: Fantastic! A vertical or tall paper gives you plenty of room to draw tall things! 🌲

question: If you are drawing a wide landscape, you hold your paper...? 🖼️
explanation: Super! A horizontal paper lets you fit a wide, beautiful view of the horizon! 🌄

question: What helps us focus on one small part of the view? 🔍
explanation: Great job! Using your fingers to make a box helps you choose the best part to draw! 📸
hint: Like taking a photo with hands.

question: What details can you see on a building that is very close? 🏢
explanation: Awesome! When things are close, we can see amazing tiny details like bricks! 🔍

question: What makes drawing everyday things super fun? 🎨
explanation: Super! Your imagination adds your own special magic to everything you draw! ✨

question: Which color mix gives you a lovely orange for sunset? 🌅
explanation: Beautiful! Mixing red and yellow together creates a wonderful, warm orange color! 🍊

question: What can you draw to show a dog barking in the distance? 🐕
explanation: Great job! Drawing the dog tiny shows that it is far away outside the window! 📏

question: If you don't have a real window, you can draw from your...? 🤔
explanation: Awesome! Our memory holds beautiful pictures of places we have seen before! 🧠

question: Who can be an amazing artist in your class? 🏫
explanation: Fantastic! Every single student has a unique and beautiful way of drawing! 🌟

question: What is the best secret to getting better at art? 🖌️
explanation: Super! Practicing a little bit every day makes your art skills grow stronger and better! 🏆
